form.label: Paste your Groq Cloud token here

missing.title: AI token required
missing.body: To use this artificial intelligence feature you need to register your own Groq Cloud token. This token is linked only to your account, is stored in an encrypted format and can be removed at any time.

errors.not_configured: AI token not configured. Register your token in settings to use this feature.
errors.invalid: Could not read your AI token. Register it again.
errors.encryption_failed: Failed to secure the AI token. Try again.
errors.unauthenticated: You must be authenticated to manage your AI token.

info.why_para1: Why do we need your token? The AI features of EthicalSoft Compliance (insight generation, ISEP results explanation, risk report and Q&A chat) consume the Groq Cloud API. So you have full control over usage, consumption and data privacy, each user uses their own personal key.
info.why_para2: Registering your token takes less than a minute, is free and gives you immediate access to all AI features of the platform.
info.security_item1: Your token is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM before being saved in the database.
info.security_item2: We never display your full token — only a mask like gsk_…Zn5tj.
info.security_item3: The token is exclusively linked to your account and is never shared with other users.
info.security_item4: In all calls, your token is sent directly to Groq Cloud.
info.security_item5: You can remove your token at any time, and removal is immediate.
info.instructions_title: How to get your Groq Cloud key (free)
info.instructions_step1: Go to console.groq.com and create an account.
info.instructions_step2: In the side panel, open API Keys and click "Create API Key".
info.instructions_step3: Give it a name (e.g. "EthicalSoft Compliance") and copy the key — it starts with gsk_…
info.instructions_step4: Come back to this screen, paste the key in the field below and click Save.
